function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment and control arms are imbalanced in severity: the control arm has a higher proportion of mild cases (378/528 ≈ 71.6%), while the treatment arm has more severe cases (132/320 ≈ 41.3%). A raw difference in response rates is therefore not a valid estimate of the treatment effect.", "implication": "The raw difference in proportions cannot be reported as the treatment effect without adjustment. function.name: note_finding
